tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All Terms and Conditions as per Tender Document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: All Technical Critiria as per Tender Document

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- All Technical bid Documents as per Tender Document

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: All vehicles must have FASTTAG Registration.

Annual Turnover exceeds towards providing of Vehicle with Drivers for Rs. 20.00 Lakh per year, Enclose the last two Financial Year 2023-24 and 2024-25, Certificate duly signed by Chartered Accountants with UDIN number
Balance sheet copies for the Financial Year 2023-24 and 2024-25 duly certified by Chartered Accountant
Certificate of registration with Goods & Service Tax Department, GST and GSTR3B of September 2026 month OR 2nd Quarter of FY 2026-27 copy should be enclosed
Copies of documents indicating satisfactory supply of outsourced Vehicles to the Government/Semi Government Departments in last two financial years FY 2023-24 and 2024-25
E M D Amount of the Tender is Rs. 49,500 as per E Tender Procurement Rules
Income TAX Returns, ITR for the Financial Year 2023-24 and 2024-25 copies
List of Vehicles for giving Services to this District, vehicle model should be 2022 onwards
Name of the Agency, detailed address, telephone number

The Bidder should not be Black Listed by any govt. Agencies and Affidavit as Self Declaration for Non Black Listed attested from Notary, Rs. 100 or more on stamp Paper, the date of the affidavit to be submitted should be after the tender date notified
Valid copy of Insurance Certificate, each vehicle
Valid copy of RC Book, each vehicle
Valid copy of Taxi permit Certificate, each vehicle
Valid copy of Vehicle Fitness Certificate, each vehicle
